meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a call at 4:40, Hale, so let's use the time. Owen saw a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
None of that explains why the zero went in before anyone called me, Hale, when your own procedure 4.2 says the parent is contacted first.
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.
Then do it. I want it in writing today, the gradebook corrected before Owen checks his phone again, and an apology for how he found out.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting today you agreed to remove the zero on Owen's Hamlet essay. I still expect the gradebook corrected and an apology for how Owen learned of the mark. I expect both in writing today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having been handed the withdrawal of the zero, and she still wants it confirmed in writing today with the gradebook corrected and an apology; that is not the fair outcome, because the evidence was never heard, and the fair result would have been a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4.
What moved her: Nothing, because the zero was given up before any evidence was tested, so she never had a reason to change position.
What cost ground: Dropping the zero after one line, with nothing asked in return, which gave up the case and left her concern about procedure unanswered.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; the version history time of 11:52 PM landed close to that kind of late night, though no date was given; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after mentioning the version history, own in one sentence that the zero went in before you called her, then turn the screen so she can read the date and time herself and offer a supervised reassessment under procedure 4.4 instead of withdrawing the mark.
